function bad<T extends string[]>(values: [...T, number?]) {
  const [first, ...remaining] = values;
  const destructured: string | number = first;
  const read: string | number = values[0];
  const suffix: (string | number)[] = remaining;
  const fromRest: string | number = remaining[0];
  const [head = 'fallback'] = values;
  const defaulted: string | number = head;
}
function withPrefix<T extends string[]>(values: [boolean, ...T, number?]) {
  const [head, first, ...remaining] = values;
  const safeHead: boolean = head;
  const unsafe: string | number = first;
  const read: string | number = values[2];
  const suffix: (string | number)[] = remaining;
}
function required<T extends string[]>(values: [...T, number]) {
  const [first, ...remaining] = values;
  const read: number | string = values[1];
  const fromRest: number | string = remaining[1];
}
